Definition: Does the government maintain a digital population register?
Comments: No credible evidence found after searching population register, national population register digital, civil register of persons, ID4D WB reports, CRVS reports; civil reg exists but paper-based fragmented with major losses post-2013 crisis.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: No source originally cited. World Bank ID4D country profile and the 2022 Public Sector Digital Governance Project appraisal document confirm CAR has no operational population register: national IDs are paper-based and civil registration is fragmented and dysfunctional post-2013 crisis. A National Digital Identity System (SNID, announced November 2025) is planned with a 2027-2032 implementation timeline and feasibility studies only completed in 2021; procurement has not yet begun, so this is a planned digital ID/civil-status consolidation, not a functioning population register. Value Code confirmed at 1 (No); the SNID initiative could justify moving to 'Planned' in a future review once it targets population-register functionality specifically and its status should be re-checked closer to 2027.
